svg.desc: A self-contained, static SVG educational interface. Simulated interactivity uses CSS :target toggles and anchor navigation only — no JavaScript, no external assets, no raster images.
svg.text: Match each label to the correct part of the flower — a hands-on botany lesson.
Drag a word-bank tile into each dashed slot, then check your answers.
These are your draggable-style labels. Match each one to a slot on the diagram.

svg.text: Self-contained SVG · no scripts, no external assets, no images.

text.tspan: Look at the flower's structure from the outside in:
• The colorful outer leaves are the petals.
• The green leaves at the very base are the sepals.
• The thin stalks with yellow tips are stamens — tip = anther,
• The central part is the pistil: sticky top = stigma,
• Everything sits on the receptacle at the stem.
Receptacle is the flower's attachment base.
